claims.citation: New York Herald, 24 July 1866, p. 3, col. 2
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Pioneer (Br), Harrison, Newcastle June 29, via
St Johns, NF, July 12, and Sydney, CB, 19th, with mdse, to
Snow & Burgess. 11th inst, lat 48 45, lon 49 10, passed a num-
ber of large iceberg; near Georges and South Shoals, saw im-
mense shoals of mackerel as far as the eye could reach; 22d,
lat 40 10, lon 70 31, passed a four masted steamer, bound E;
also a bark rigged steamer, bound E; off South Shoal, passed
five large ships, bound W.
